name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees, back knee just above the floor.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg through into the next step.
Keep your chest up and alternate legs as you walk forward.

name: Medicine Ball Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly and lift your feet. Hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Keep your back long and brace your core.
Rotate your torso to one side and tap the ball near the floor.
Rotate to the other side. Each side counts as one rep.

name: Side Plank Single Leg Crunch
instructions: Lie on your side and prop yourself on your forearm in a side plank, hips lifted.
Place your free hand behind your head.
Draw your top knee up toward your elbow while bringing the elbow down to meet it.
Extend back out under control. Finish all reps, then switch sides.

name: Hip Thrust Machine
instructions: Sit with your upper back against the pad and the belt or lever across your hips.
Plant your feet flat, about hip width apart.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso is level, squeezing your glutes.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: Crunch Clap
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and arms stretched overhead.
Curl your shoulders and chest off the floor while swinging your arms forward.
Clap your hands in front of your knees at the top.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

name: Medicine Ball Sit Up & Overhead Throw
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Sit up fast and throw the ball forward to a partner or a wall.
Catch the ball on the return and lower your back to the floor under control.
Reset the ball overhead and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Upright Row
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding a kettlebell by the handle in front of your thighs.
Pull the kettlebell up along your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop around chest height with elbows at or just below shoulder level.
Lower slowly to the start.

name: Kettlebell Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with feet wider than your shoulders and toes turned out, holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of you.
Keep your chest tall and sit your hips down between your knees.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor, knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your whole foot to stand back up.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a strong stretch in the back of your thighs.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand tall.

name: Machine Assisted Pull Up
instructions: Set the assistance weight, kneel or stand on the platform and grip the bars slightly wider than your shoulders.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back.
Lower yourself fully under control until your arms are straight.
Log the assistance weight: less assistance means you are lifting more of your own bodyweight.

name: Burpee
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor in front of your feet.
Jump or step your feet back into a high plank, then lower your chest to the floor.
Push up, jump or step your feet back to your hands, then jump up with your arms overhead. That is one rep.

name: Jumping Jack
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Jump your feet out wide while swinging your arms up over your head.
Jump your feet back together as your arms come back down to your sides.
Keep a steady rhythm and land softly on the balls of your feet.

name: Bear Crawl
instructions: Start on your hands and knees, hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Lift your knees an inch or two off the floor, keeping your back flat.
Crawl forward by moving the opposite hand and foot together in small steps.
Keep your hips low and your core tight for the whole time.

name: High Knees
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Run on the spot, driving each knee up to hip height.
Pump your arms and stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your chest up and go as fast as you can with good form.

name: Skater Jump
instructions: Stand on your right leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Jump sideways to the left and land softly on your left leg.
Let your right leg swing behind you and touch lightly without putting weight on it.
Jump back to the right. Each jump counts as one rep.

name: Knee-to-Wall Ankle Mobilization
instructions: Stand facing a wall in a split stance, front toes a few centimetres from the wall.
Keep the front heel down and drive the front knee forward to touch the wall.
Hold for 2 seconds at the end, then return. Move the foot back as it gets easier.

name: Bent-Knee Calf Stretch
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot behind the other, hands on the wall.
Bend both knees and sink down, keeping the back heel on the floor.
Hold where you feel the stretch low in the back calf, then switch sides.

name: Half-Kneeling Adductor Stretch
instructions: Kneel on one knee and take the other leg straight out to the side, foot flat.
Keep your chest tall and shift your hips gently away from the straight leg.
Hold where you feel the stretch along the inner thigh, then switch sides.

name: Supine Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back and loop a band or towel around one foot.
Keep the leg straight and pull it up until you feel a stretch behind the thigh.
Keep the other leg flat on the floor. Hold, then switch sides.

name: Doorway Pec Stretch
instructions: Stand in a doorway with forearms on the frame, elbows at shoulder height.
Step one foot through and lean forward gently until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Keep your ribs down and hold without arching your low back.

name: Kneeling Lat Stretch
instructions: Kneel facing a bench or chair and rest your forearms or hands on it.
Sit your hips back towards your heels and let your chest sink down.
Hold where you feel the stretch along the sides of your back.

name: Thoracic Extension on Foam Roller
instructions: Lie back over a foam roller placed across your upper back, hands behind your head.
Keep your hips on the floor and gently extend your upper back over the roller.
Return, then move the roller a few centimetres and repeat. Avoid the low back.

name: Open Book
instructions: Lie on your side, knees bent to 90 degrees, arms straight out in front together.
Keep your knees together and open the top arm across your body towards the floor behind you.
Follow your hand with your eyes, pause, then close the book. Do all reps, then switch sides.

name: Cross-Body Stretch
instructions: Bring one arm across your chest at shoulder height.
Use the other hand above the elbow to pull it gently closer.
Keep the shoulder down away from your ear. Hold, then switch sides.

name: Sleeper Stretch
instructions: Lie on your side with the bottom arm out in front, elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Use the top hand to gently press the bottom forearm down towards the floor.
Stop at a gentle stretch at the back of the shoulder; never push into pain.

name: Banded Lateral Walk
instructions: Place a band around your legs just above the knees or at the ankles.
Sit into a slight squat and step sideways, keeping the knees pushed out against the band.
Keep your trunk still and toes forward. Step the same number of times each way.

name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
instructions: Lie on your side with the bottom knee bent and the top leg straight.
Lift the top leg up and slightly back, toes pointing forward, without rolling your hips back.
Lower slowly. Do all reps, then switch sides.

name: Clamshell
instructions: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent and feet together.
Keep the feet touching and lift the top knee, without rolling your pelvis back.
Lower slowly. Add a band above the knees to make it harder.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips until your body is in a line from knees to shoulders.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly without arching your low back.

name: Step-Down
instructions: Stand on a low step on one leg, the other foot hanging off the side.
Slowly bend the standing knee and lower the other heel to tap the floor, knee over the middle of the foot.
Push back up through the standing leg. Do all reps, then switch sides.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a weight, standing knee slightly bent.
Hinge at the hip, reaching the weight down as the free leg goes back, hips level.
Stop when you feel the hamstring stretch and stand back up. Switch sides.

name: Heel-Elevated Goblet Squat
instructions: Stand with your heels on a small plate or wedge, holding a weight at your chest.
Squat down between your legs, keeping the chest up and knees over the toes.
Drive back up through the whole foot.

name: Dowel Hip Hinge
instructions: Hold a dowel along your back so it touches your head, upper back and tailbone.
Push your hips back with soft knees, keeping all three points on the dowel.
Stand back up by driving your hips forward.

name: Quadruped Rock Back
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Rock your hips back towards your heels as far as you can without your low back rounding.
Return to the start and repeat slowly.

name: Bird Dog
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your body.
Hold for a few seconds without your hips tipping, then switch sides.

name: Suitcase Carry
instructions: Hold a heavy weight in one hand by your side.
Walk tall without leaning towards or away from the weight.
Walk the distance, then switch hands.

name: Active Leg Lowering
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs pointing straight up.
Keep your low back on the floor and slowly lower one leg towards the floor.
Bring it back up and switch legs.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel with your ankles held down by a partner or a fixed bar.
Keeping a straight line from knees to head, lower yourself forward as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands and push back up to the start.

name: Short Foot Exercise
instructions: Sit or stand with your foot flat on the floor.
Shorten the foot by pulling the ball of the foot towards the heel, lifting the arch without curling the toes.
Hold for 5 seconds, then relax.

name: Single-Leg Balance
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee, the other foot off the floor.
Keep your hips level and your foot steady.
Hold for the time, then switch sides. Close your eyes to make it harder.

name: Single-Leg Balance with Reach
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Reach the other foot forward, to the side and behind as far as you can while staying balanced.
Return to the middle each time. Switch sides.

name: Push-Up Plus
instructions: Start in a push-up position (on knees or toes).
Do a push-up, then at the top push the floor away further so the shoulder blades spread apart.
Lower the shoulder blades back and repeat.

name: Supine Dumbbell Serratus Punch
instructions: Lie on your back holding a light dumbbell straight up over your shoulder.
Keep the elbow straight and punch the weight towards the ceiling, lifting the shoulder blade off the floor.
Lower the shoulder blade back down slowly.

name: Wall Slide
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall, forearms on the wall in a goalpost position.
Slide your arms up the wall as far as you can while keeping your low back and forearms on the wall.
Slide back down slowly.

name: Prone Y Raise
instructions: Lie face down with arms overhead in a Y shape, thumbs up.
Lift your arms off the floor by drawing your shoulder blades down and back.
Hold for 2 seconds, then lower.

name: Prone T Raise (Thumbs Up)
instructions: Lie face down with arms straight out to the sides, thumbs up.
Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold for 2 seconds, then lower.

name: Side-Lying External Rotation
instructions: Lie on your side with the top elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked against your side.
Holding a light dumbbell, rotate the forearm up towards the ceiling, keeping the elbow in place.
Lower slowly. Do all reps, then switch sides.

name: Half-Kneeling Landmine Press
instructions: Kneel on one knee holding the end of a landmine bar at your shoulder on the same side as the down knee.
Press the bar up and forward until the arm is straight, letting the shoulder blade move forward.
Lower under control. Do all reps, then switch sides.

name: Chin Tuck
instructions: Sit or stand tall, looking straight ahead.
Glide your chin straight back, making a double chin, without tilting your head down.
Hold for a few seconds, then relax.
